notes: Latching lyrics onto a track (switching on "Stick to the singer's track", picking a track, or dragging onto one) now resets Move up / down, so the words land dead-centre on the lane instead of keeping an old offset. Lyrics stuck to a track are as tall as the lane in every style. Also in this update: no more grain in renders, Freedit cameras keep every track in frame, faster short intros, circle pictures fill square intros, and the next singer moves up the moment a take ends.
